name: Francis M.
title: Excellent Service
text: I have been taking my vehicles to Burns Auto since 2015. Although I moved further away I still bring both cars back when maintenance or repairs are due. Honest, Friendly and knowledgeable mechanics who do a fine job.

name: Eric P.
title: 2008 Ford F-150
text: Had my truck inspected, oil changed, and brake light on the dash staying on. Also had Burns look over the truck since it's not used too often. They were able to repair dash light issue for a reasonable price. Left truck for the day, was done mid-afternoon. Mechanic called and explained everything.

name: Bessie S.
text: As always, everyone and everything was professional and courteous

name: Lisa F.
title: Excellent customer service!
text: Burns Auto has been servicing all of our vehicles since we moved here over 20 years ago, and they are simply the best in every attribute!

name: Kenneth C.
title: Awesome work . Always done right the first time.
text: Friendly professional

name: Steven P.
title: Great service
text: Always provides excellent and friendly service at a great price.

name: Jane S.
title: Came in for an oil change and a battery check
text: As always, great job! Everyone is very helpful and informative. Quick efficient. Thanks so much.

name: Jacqueline C.
title: Always does a great job
text: We have been going to Burns for years and they have always done a great job. They are able fit us in, even when we call a couple of days before the inspection is due, like for this trip. We have had inspections, oil changes, brakes and many other repairs to name a few.

name: James P.
title: Always professional
text: Lucky to have Burns in the neighborhood

name: Ronald L.
title: Always quick friendly service
text: We have been getting our cars serviced here for 10+ years. Hope things never change. Fair, quick, reliable service from a family owned business. The same quality and care that goes into the business (shop & garage are always clean and organized; employees always friendly and courteous) goes into your vehicles. Excellent & much appreciated work and service Burns, thank you!

name: Judy W.
title: Always excellent!!
text: We have been taking our cars to Burns Auto for many many years. It is easy to get an appointment, the service is always excellent, and the advice extremely helpful. I recommend them without reservation.

name: Jody C.
title: Honesty
text: If you are looking for an honest and professional auto repair company, Burns Auto repair is the place to go.

name: Frank B.
title: Car inspection
text: Very thorough very professional. Great people to work with will bring all my cars there anytime any day.

name: Shannon T.
title: Wonderful service with a smile!
text: I'm always pleased with service done on my vehicle and the customer service at Burn's Auto. Every single person there is so friendly and helpful. They do a great job! Honest and reasonably priced.

name: David E.
title: Always pleased…
text: I have said it before and I will say it again, Burns' is a professionally run service station. Our go to for nearly 30 years!

name: Stephanie C.
title: Burns is honest and professional!
text: I keep returning because of how incredible they are.

name: Rose Lynne B.
title: Experience
text: Very professional and competent staff. I would recommend this business to my friends and neighbors.

name: Myles K.
title: Never Gets Old
text: Even if I'm an old guy. Burns Auto Repair caring for family cars for years and years.Nice to know the work will be done right and we will be treated right.

name: Jayme T.
title: Always the best
text: We've been going to Burns for all our auto servicing needs for over 20 years. Always friendly, efficient and reliable, our only disappointment is not chatting with Dave (Senior) when we're there. But he richly deserved to retire and his son and crew are carrying on this family business superbly!

name: Roland H.
title: Great service appointment
text: For my oil change and inspection - another great experience - quick turn around, professional service and reasonable prices. I‘m a fan

name: Michael K.
title: State Inspection
text: I chose to wait for the inspection. It was completed as promised and I was happy to know my car was safe.

name: James L.
title: Confidence
text: It's nice to have confidence in an auto repair shop to do what is needed, and no more. In the past, they discovered problems that were unknown to me. Great shop and people.

name: Anne B.
title: Always trustworthy
text: My 20 year old car is my lifeline right now. Burns Auto always provides excellent service.

name: Edwin T.
title: Always GREAT Service
text: I'm always pleased with any visit to Burn's Auto. Work on my vehicle is always done thoroughly, no matter what is getting done. And all of the guys working there are all so pleasant to deal with.

name: Jeffrey P.
title: The best mechanics in Newtown PA
text: I've been going to Burns auto repair for a long time my family and I think highly of the mechanics. They are reliable honest and can fix and do everything and anything. They are great guys as well.

name: Jane S.
title: Oil change!
text: Awesome as usual. Prompt and very courteous! Dave always takes care to acknowledge my concerns. As do Doug and John. Great job!

name: David E.
title: Excellent service
text: Always appreciate the professionalism and service

name: Robert D.
title: Great Place to Go for your Auto Needs
text: Been going to Burns for over 35 years. Great mechanics and friendly service.

name: Geraldine P.
title: Excellent and very accommodating
text: Always happy to come there to have my car serviced

name: Regina C.
title: The mechanics who work there are the best So honest and trusting.
text: I like everyone who works there. I was recently there to get oil & filter change how lucky was I the battery in my SUV died there. They checked to see when was my last battery out in 5 years ago. Of course I got a new one. John Doug and Dave are all great. They know I always wait there to get my car done so they do accommodate me.

name: Jan C.
title: Perfect service, excellent!
text: I have used Dave Burns Auto for 37 years. Really great service, professional work, caring attitude, family business.

name: William J.
title: Burns Newtown
text: My visits are always great shout out to John, the superstar Of all techs. Been a customer a long time and will always be. Better than dealers for sure.

name: Susan C.
title: Great place for car service
text: I wouldn't take my SUV anywhere else for servicing. Reasonable prices and they do a great job.

name: Jeannie K.
title: Trustworthy best mechanics
text: I have been going to Burns for almost 20 years. I trust them with all my cars. Discounts at other locations are not worth my time.

name: Nicholas W.
title: Burns Auto Repair... Forty years of great service!
text: Dave, and his dad before him, have been my go-to people because of not only ezcellent workmanship, but reasonable prices. And... they do NOT try to sell me unnecessary products or services (like the dealers do).

name: Daniel M.
title: Inspection and brake pad replacement
text: Always prompt and friendly service.

name: Dean P.
title: Amazing service
text: Burns never disappoints - they provide top notch service and a high level of integrity which is hard to come by these days.

name: Steven G.
title: Burns Auto is the best auto repair around. Highly recommend them!
text: Our experiences have developed many times throughout history when one or more risks have emerged for a banking sector as a whole.

name: Judy W.
title: Always an excellent experience
text: I have been having my car serviced at Burns auto for many many years. I can always get a timely appointment and I know that my car is in good hands, will be well diagnosed and serviced if needed. Everyone there is friendly, professional, and knowledgeable. I recommend them without reservation!

name: Stasia K.
title: Always a great experience!
text: I only needed an oil change and a sensor light checked and replaced. All was completed same day. There is a service station that I can walk to from my house but I choose to go to Burns.

name: David E.
title: Another great experience
text: They are always professional and complete their work in a timely fashion. We have been customers for 25 years.

name: Cindy C.
title: Service
text: I have taken my cars to Burns for service forever! I trust them - and I know they will never tell me I need something that I don't. They do what they say and are great to deal with.

name: Steven B.
title: Excellent, honest, affordable service
text: They are always nice, easy to work with, honest, affordable, reliable,and straightforward. I have been coming here since we moved here in 2008. My dad moved here in 1996 and recommended them to me.

name: Gary B.
title: Great Company
text: Staff professional and efficient, competent and polite...work done was complete and reasonably priced. Shop and office neat and tidy with easy access for the elderly. They have been quite reliable...would use again in the future.

name: Anne B.
title: Trust this reliable service!
text: My car is my life line and all the techs are patient, courteous, and total pros!

name: Eugene G.
title: Honest inspection
text: I put my car in the shop expecting my brakes needing to be replaced. Fortunately for me, it was just a bad sensor. I appreciate Burns Auto just fixing the sensor and not charging me for new brakes!

name: Nicholas W.
title: Always excellent service and advice!
text: Dave Burns and his crew have provided excellent advice and service for me for over twenty years. I will continue to bring our vehicles to Burns Auto.
